cs: a soft silver-white ductile metallic element (liquid at normal temperatures)
cs gas: a tear gas that is stronger than CN gas but wears off faster
cse: Canadian agency that gathers communications intelligence and assist law enforcement and security agencies

cst: standard time in the 6th time zone west of Greenwich, reckoned at the 90th meridian
